concern_summary: This concern focuses on managing custom field records and custom segment records in the context of NetSuite integration, including operations such as retrieval, display, and removal of these records.
This concern addresses the validation, display, and management of custom segment records, ensuring they have unique identifiers, required fields, and appropriate field labels for user interaction.
This concern encompasses the validation, checking, and updating of data records to ensure data integrity within a collection.
This concern addresses the management of the report hold process, including checking the current status of reports on hold and managing the visibility and interactions related to the hold menu.
This concern deals with the right hand panel's navigation and state management, ensuring the correct root routes are displayed and handling user interactions related to the right hand pane.
This concern focuses on filtering and managing visibility related to reports and actions based on identifiers, ensuring the appropriate display and access control in user contexts.
This concern involves handling transaction identifiers, ensuring accurate tracking and management of transactions throughout various stages of the money request process.
This concern relates to policy identifiers and their roles in managing and updating specific attributes related to policies within the application, especially in transaction contexts.
This concern focuses on navigating and managing the state of reports within the report handling process, including ensuring that users can return to open reports without losing their context.
